caption: The drawing contains two depictions of the same object, which is a fireplace andiron. On the right, there is a detailed colored illustration showing an andiron with a long, vertical body that tapers slightly upward, terminating in a decorative finial at the top. The finial is gold in color, and the body of the andiron is a dark metal, possibly black or dark gray. There is a horizontal support rod extending perpendicular to the main body, and the base consists of curved metal legs forming three points of contact with the ground. A brass or gold-colored rectangular element is visible where the vertical portion meets the legs. On the left, there is a simplified, uncolored line drawing of the same andiron, viewed from the front, which omits the depth and horizontal bar, and a small scale in inches is included at the bottom for reference. The illustration is surrounded by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border on a tan or light beige background. The artist's name, J. Stialoff, is written at the bottom right of the image.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
